**Green. 625 passing, 0 failing.**

Three cases failed, all in `order totals`. `orderTotal` taxed the full price, not the discounted one.

```
orderTotal(12000, 15, 0.0825)  expected 11042, got 11190
```

Fix in [src/pricing.js:39](src/pricing.js:39). Tax now runs on the discounted amount.

Only rows with both a discount and a tax caught it. The other 66 rows had one or the other at zero.

Next: nothing.
